readme.run: Compute melanin, hemoglobin, ITA° maps and CIEDE2000 skin colorimetry
notes: Input is a JPEG or PNG dermatology or dermoscopy image.
Pass --white-balance for Shades of Gray (p=6) linear-RGB white balance.
Pass --roi-mode auto|central to select automatic lesion ROI or fixed central 25% disk.
No network connection is required and no external model weights are downloaded.
EI, MI, melanin OD and hemoglobin OD are uncalibrated fixed-basis RGB optical-density proxies (not calibrated spectrophotometry).
